title: Day 6: Deep Learning: Perceptrons, MLPs, RBF/SOM & Convolutions
subtitle: Perceptrons, Backpropagation, Activations, RBF/SOM Networks, 2D CNN Parameter Math & Explainable AI (XAI)

summary: Dive into deep representation learning. Experience exact step-by-step backpropagation replicating the NUS ISS ANN-BP-v006 benchmark spreadsheet.
